How to build a mind
that doesn't break

1. Expect hard days.

They stop surprising you.

2. Write down your worries.

On paper, they shrink.

3. Train your body.

The mind follows.

4. Keep one honest friend.

Not a fan. A friend.

5. Learn every day.

Understanding kills fear.
slides.texte_sophia:
5. Learn every day.

Use a micro-learning app
like the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
7. Keep moving forward.

Slow is still forward.
